subject: bindinfo: SetSkipPlanCache use nostack errors (#50585)
summary: The diff is a mechanical switch from stack-capturing `errors.New/Errorsf` to `errors.NewNoStackError*` for reasons passed into `StmtCtx.SetSkipPlanCache/ForceSetSkipPlanCache` across executor/expression/planner (and one ranger helper). Verified in `pkg/sessionctx/stmtctx/stmtctx.go` that `SetSkipPlanCache`/`setSkipPlanCache` only consume `reason.Error()` to build warnings and do not rely on stack traces, so SQL semantics / planner-executor behavior / plan-cache correctness remain unchanged while reducing per-call overhead. A quick scan of later history on `upstream/master` shows only similar “avoid generating stack for warnings” follow-ups, with no revert/fix suggesting a functional regression from this change.
